title: Getting Around
text:
Many people travel by bus or train. Trains are fast and comfortable. My uncle takes the train to his office every day. The station is near his house.

Some people like to travel by bike. Bikes are cheap and good for the environment. My sister rides her bike to school. She has a yellow bike.

questions.text: How does my uncle travel to his office?
What colour is my sister's bike?
What can we infer about the uncle?
options: He lives close to a train station

questions.text: What can we infer about the sister?
options: She does not go to school

vocabulary.definition: feeling good and relaxed, without pain or problems
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on or off
the natural world around us, such as air, water and land
the colour of the sun or of a banana

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan otobüsle ya da trenle seyahat eder. Trenler hızlı ve rahattır. Amcam her gün işine trenle gider. İstasyon evinin yakınındadır.
Bazı insanlar bisikletle seyahat etmeyi sever. Bisikletler ucuzdur ve çevre için iyidir. Kız kardeşim okula bisikletiyle gider. Onun sarı bir bisikleti var.
